notice.title: Advertisement for 47 posts of Sub Inspector (AB) & 3 posts of Constable (AB) in Assam Commando Battalions. Advertisement

registration_deadline.evidence: All documents uploaded and submitted at the time of PST & PET must be issued on or before the last date of submission of online Applications. (i.e. 16-01-2026)

registration_open.evidence: Online Applications will be received with effect from 16-12-2025 to 16-01-2026, and in case of any inadvertent entry/typographical mistakes, edit option will be available for 5 days from the last date of submission of Online Application by

age_as_on.evidence: 5.5.B Constable (AB) - The age of the Applicant must be 18-21 years as on 01-01-2026

limits.evidence: 5.5.A Sub Inspector (AB) - The age of the Applicant must be 20-24 years as on 01-01-2026 (i.e., Applicants born not before 01-01-2002 and not later than 01-01-2006)
5.5.B Constable (AB) - The age of the Applicant must be 18-21 years as on 01-01-2026

pay.evidence: In pursuance of the directions of the Govt. of Assam, Online Applications are invited for filling up of 47 posts of Sub Inspector (AB) & 3 posts of Constable (AB) in Assam Commando Battalions in the Pay Scale of Rs. 14000-70000/- (Pay Band No. 2) and Grade Pay as shown against each post plus other…

exam_pattern.paper: For chin ups more than 14 times no extra marks will be awarded
